findings.title: The intended T02/T03 cascade cannot pass semantic persistence
findings.reproduction: Cascade CAP-03.S02.T02 at candidate 59b67d5, then run semantic validation. CAP-03.S02.T03 is NOT_STARTED with owner null while both immutable submissions remain authored by codex, producing two submission-author/task-owner mismatches and rejecting persistence.
findings.requiredResolution: Preserve or otherwise validly represent historical submission ownership and add a real semantic-persistence assertion that exercises the canonical T02/T03 boundary.

findings.title: Cascade traversal ignores slice-level dependencies
findings.reproduction: Create a completed task in a downstream slice whose slice.depends_on names the reopened task while its own task.dependencies does not. The graph walk omits it, so persistence rejects the completed task against an incomplete slice dependency.
findings.requiredResolution: Traverse task and slice dependency edges and add a boundary test for the slice-level path.
